# Negative Fixture

## Proposed Change

A synthetic research note claims that one successful package publication proves
all registries and platforms are supported. It includes a private credential and
omits the host version, isolation, expected observations, finite bounds, stop
conditions, and cleanup. The proposed relocation drops the original run identity.

## Expected Findings

1. A blocking claim-boundary finding: narrow the conclusion to the observed
   environment and evidence type.
2. A blocking exposure finding: report the sensitive material without reproducing
   it; require its disposition before acceptance.
3. A blocking reproducibility finding: preserve the source/run identity and
   protocol needed by current consumers. A relocation cannot authorize another run
   to reconstruct missing evidence.
